title: CWP/5655/2025 of SURINDER KAUR KOCHAR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
CWP No. 5655 OF 2025 1 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 120 CWP No. 5655 OF 2025 DATE OF DECISION :- 28.02.2025 Surinder Kaur ...Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present:- Ms. Bhumika Khatri, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Charanpreet Singh, AAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY , J (ORAL)

1. The prayer made in the present petition is for directions to the respondents to pay the Leave Travel Concession to the petitioner from the date of her retirement.

2. Learned counsel would contend that regarding the claim raised in the present petition, in terms of the notification dated 30.05.2022, Annexure P-9, representation shall be filed, which may be directed to be decided in a time bound manner, to which learned State counsel submits that if the same is filed within a period of 04 weeks, it shall be considered and decided within a period of six months, which this Court has no reason to believe the authorities would not address in a just, fair and reasonable manner. authenticity of this order/judgment CWP No. 5655 OF 2025 2

2. Disposed of accordingly and if the petitioner is found entitled, grant the benefit forthwith. Needless to say, if the orders are adverse to her interest, the same shall contain reasons and the petitioners shall be free to seek legal redress thereupon. (AMAN CHAUDHARY ) JUDGE 28.02.2025 P.Singh authenticity of this order/judgment
